Name: Snowy Terrain
Effect: Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Ice-Type Moves. Non Ice-Type Active Combatant's Dexterity is reduced by 1. Duration 4 Rounds.
Description: The User suddenly chills the area, blanketing it in a gentle frost. The chill of the air hinders the Movement of those not accustomed to the cold and snow, slowing their speed as they navigate through the wintry landscape.
